relationship.purpose: localize the post-full-basis reference loss to hierarchy/top-boundary adaptation, standard final compilation, or a shared same-budget mapping/calibration limit
relationship.architecture_line: C68E-repaired repository Residual-MLP at Gaussian sigma=.36

H: Because C70E showed numerically exact P64 calibration residual reconstruction but invalid final reference performance, the remaining task gap is generated after target construction. A fresh three-stage comparison can localize whether the dominant loss appears in P64 hierarchy adaptation, standard hierarchy-to-final compilation, or a shared 4096-parameter/calibration-generalization limit.
T: Use fresh model seeds 69400-69415 and verification seed 69300. Reproduce the exact C68E robust teacher and C70E P64 full-basis shifted-calibration target. Evaluate: H64 = the P64-adapted 4096-parameter recursive hierarchy directly before compilation; S64 = the standard 4096-parameter TinyRes(64,32) compiler fitted to H64 calibration outputs; D64 = an identically initialized/fitted 4096-parameter TinyRes(64,32) fitted directly to repaired-teacher shifted-calibration final activations, bypassing hierarchy-target distillation. All three use the same shifted validation tensor and frozen teacher stem/head.
D: First require repaired-target validity and the P64 calibration full-basis implementation invariant. Then apply the same -5 pp task-reference validity safeguard separately to H64, S64 and D64. If S64 and H64 are both valid, classify the C70E final-reference failure as not reproduced. If S64 is invalid but H64 valid, localize standard compilation loss. If S64 and H64 are invalid but D64 valid, localize hierarchy/top-boundary adaptation loss. If S64/H64/D64 are all invalid, localize only to a shared 4096-parameter mapping or calibration-generalization limit. If H64 invalid but S64 valid, stop as nonmonotonic compiler rescue rather than forcing a bottleneck label.
C: A same-budget direct compiler may also be invalid, implying the issue is not specific to recursive hierarchy adaptation.
The standard compiler may regularize an invalid hierarchy and become valid, producing a nonmonotonic stage pattern that should not be relabeled as a simple bottleneck.
Fresh-cohort variation may make the C70E P64 failure not reproduce; that outcome requires separate treatment rather than post-hoc localization.
Calibration generalization, optimization and 4096-parameter function capacity are confounded if both H64 and D64 fail.
U: Task-reference validity uses the preregistered -5 pp accuracy safeguard and does not prove activation equivalence.
D64 is a mechanistic bypass condition, not a deployable replacement claim or interface candidate.
This stage study does not select a reduced interface dimension and cannot confirm P8/P16 from C69E.
The experiment is scoped to the exact repaired-teacher recipe, sigma=.36, 192 calibration samples and 4096-parameter replacement budget.

hierarchy_and_shift.base_hierarchy: same C61R-C70E 4096-parameter recursive hierarchy built from repaired-teacher clean-training activations
hierarchy_and_shift.p64_basis: all 64 columns of canonical QR of shifted-calibration repaired-teacher residual transpose

stages.H64: P64-adapted recursive hierarchy, evaluated directly with frozen repaired-teacher stem/head before final compilation
stages.S64: standard TinyRes(64,32) final compiler fitted to H64 shifted-calibration outputs
stages.D64: same architecture, initialization seed, fit seed and batch-index stream as S64, but fitted directly to repaired-teacher shifted-calibration final activations

training_seeds.shared_compiler_seed_rationale: S64 and D64 differ only in target tensor under identical compiler initialization and minibatch sampling

eligibility.eligible_seed_if: robust teacher/hierarchy complete, exact 4096 recursive budget holds, P64 full-basis calibration reconstruction relative error<=1e-10, H64/S64/D64 accuracies and NMSE diagnostics are finite, and S64/D64 NMSE are positive

target_task_validity.statistic: paired robust-teacher shifted minus clean validation accuracy
target_task_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap95 lower bound > -20 pp

stage_reference_validity.statistic: paired stage shifted-validation accuracy minus robust-teacher shifted-validation accuracy
stage_reference_validity.pass: paired percentile bootstrap95 lower bound > -5 pp

rules: else if target validity fails: STOP_ROBUST_TARGET_INVALID
else if H64 valid and S64 valid: STOP_C70_P64_FAILURE_NOT_REPRODUCED

else if H64 invalid and S64 invalid and D64 invalid: LOCALIZE_SHARED_MAPPING_OR_CALIBRATION_LIMIT
